data.gender_notes: Tadeo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Aramaic word ‘laddawna’, meaning ‘courageous’, Thaddeus is a name given to one of the twelve apostles. Also known as Judas son of James, Tadeo is remembered for his steadfastness and loyalty to Jesus. The name Tadeo carries the meaning “Thaddeus, a disciple” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tadeo usually hope their child will grow to embody thaddeus, a disciple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
